evidence.excerpt: Svetlana Sabo received her Diploma Engineer degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Novi Sad in 1998 and her PhD from the same institution in 2005, with a thesis on moisture transport across elastomeric seals in low-pressure enclosures. She joined the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Faculty of Technical Sciences as an Assistant Professor in 2006 and was promoted to Full Professor in 2018. Her research group focuses on thermal-fluid behaviour inside sealed cavities, with particular emphasis on hygrothermal modelling, condensation onset prediction, and the influence of seal geometry and vapour permeability on internal dew-point conditions. She teaches courses in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and machine elements. The group operates a climate-controlled test chamber, a gravimetric vapour sorption analyser, and a suite of infrared thermography equipment.
